answer: Joining costs an anchor fee that burns: 5 credits while the join rate is calm, posted on the public ledge, rising with each registration that epoch. Auditors read the ledge and reprice each time, so the kth fake pays roughly 5 + k/10 credits, never reusable. A batch of 1,000 fakes burns about 55,000 credits, while a lone honest nectar seller joining early pays only 5. A staggered-registration dodge fails: the fee counts every registration in the epoch, so spreading the batch only delays it while the surcharge keeps rising.
